question: Q-006
reason: checked as the owner's delegate. The scenario's THEN clauses hold. Both Grants e2e tests match them point by point and pass at head 3eebb70a (e2e/test_m6b_admin.py 8/8 on a private stack, twice). The rows test fails at base e62be04a; the error-state test guards kept behaviour and passes at base by design. But the criterion is not met as its requirement stands. (1) The hint "A role, for example author, or a user id from the Users page." under "Role or user" appears in no source file (grep), as Q-016 found. (2) The "New grant" card's heading is squeezed beside the form ("New / grant" on two lines). In the error state it is drawn over "Subject" and the "Role" radio (screenshots at 1366 by 860). Cause: the kit's .ui-section is a grid with grid-template-columns minmax(0, 1fr) auto, and nothing spans the body, so a Section without actions puts its first child in the auto column beside the heading. The same defect crushes "Chain verification" (its status box covers the heading), "Create team", "Map a group" and "Surface". One added rule fixes all six; I tried it locally: .ui-section > :not(.ui-section-title, .ui-section-actions) { grid-column: 1 / -1; }. With it, the 8 admin e2e tests and web/src/kit/theme-restyle.test.ts still pass. WHEN the Grants page is open at 1366 by 860 with the rows and with the error state of its two e2e tests, and the Roles and teams, Group mappings, Audit log and Tool servers pages are open as in their tests in e2e/test_m6b_admin.py THEN in each of the regions "New grant", "Create team", "Map a group", "Chain verification", "Filter the audit log" and "Surface" the heading is on one line (its height is less than twice its font size) and every other child of the region starts at the heading's left edge within 1 px and at or below the heading's bottom edge.
